shape: Dead-end with center pivot + ring of corner pockets (single south gate)
description: Single-portal dead-end room with a south entry hub (z8nffe), a center pivot (k8g99f) that fans out to four corner detour pockets (NE, north-center, NW, W), and two south-side detour pockets (S-W pfcf7p and E nbxfdt) hanging off the entry hub. After kill_all / objective sequence, return to spawn_south. Same dead-end-with-sub-zones family as paru-A na1, wetlands-A na1/nb2.

portals.south: spawn_south at (5.08, 19.93) — the only portal, on the south (high-Z) side

anchors.description: center pivot — fans out to 4 corner pockets (matches k8g99f)

traversalNotes: DEAD-END. Enter and leave via spawn_south.
DISPATCH RULE: south-side objectives via south_inner; corner-pocket objectives via center → corner → reverse.
Star topology around the center: corner pockets do NOT interconnect — every cross-pocket transit goes through the center pivot.
